aboutGame.title: What is Weather Sandbox?
paragraphs: Weather Sandbox is a Roblox weather simulation game developed by Beyond Average. You control temperature, wind, humidity, and air pressure to build storms in real time, then watch the simulation respond as clouds, rain, lightning, and tornadoes form across the map.

Players experiment with everything from a calm clear-sky baseline to a Category-scale hurricane, unlocking new biomes and tools as they master the atmosphere. With over 963K visits and an 85% user rating, Weather Sandbox turns the sky into a sandbox you can pause, rewind, and rebuild.

modules.name: Weather Sandbox Beginner Guide
modules.description: A step-by-step starter walkthrough covering the core weather parameters, your first-session setup, and beginner experiments to run in Weather Sandbox.

highlights.detail: Reset to a clear sky and set a baseline time of day
Raise surface temperature to build instability
Push humidity toward saturation so a cloud base forms
Trigger lift with terrain, a heat source, or a front
Add wind shear to tilt the updraft and organize rotation
Enable precipitation, then tune intensity and duration

modules.name: Weather Sandbox Weather Controls
modules.description: Every core weather dial in Weather Sandbox - temperature, humidity, air pressure, wind, cloud cover, and precipitation - with practical starting ranges.

highlights.label: Temperature
highlights.detail: 60-75 F (15-24 C) - energy stored in the air

highlights.label: Humidity
highlights.detail: 50-70% - moisture available for clouds and rain

highlights.label: Pressure
highlights.detail: Near standard sea level - lower values drive lift and storms

highlights.label: Wind Speed
highlights.detail: 5-15 mph - faster movement and more mixing

highlights.label: Cloud Cover
highlights.detail: 20-50% - shading and storm fuel

highlights.label: Time of Day
highlights.detail: Mid-morning - stronger convection and longer heating

modules.name: Weather Sandbox Storm Guide
modules.description: How to create storms in Weather Sandbox by combining moisture, instability, lift, and wind shear, then tuning thunder, lightning, and rain.

highlights.label: Moisture
highlights.detail: Supplies the water that becomes cloud and rain; raise humidity toward saturation

highlights.label: Unstable
highlights.detail: Warm surface air keeps rising on its own and builds tall clouds

highlights.label: Lift
highlights.detail: Terrain, fronts, or a heat source gives the first upward push

highlights.label: Shear
highlights.detail: Tilts the updraft, separates rain from the core, and extends storm life

highlights.label: Mountains

highlights.label: Coast
highlights.detail: Warm water fuels hurricanes and sharpens sea-breeze fronts

highlights.label: Desert
highlights.detail: Dry air starves storms, so moisture must be added first

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Weather Sandbox.

items.question: What is Weather Sandbox?
items.answer: Weather Sandbox is a Roblox weather simulation game by Beyond Average. You control temperature, wind, humidity, and air pressure to create storms, unlock biomes, and experiment with the atmosphere in real time.

items.question: How do you control the weather in Weather Sandbox?
items.answer: Open the weather control panel and adjust temperature, humidity, air pressure, wind speed, wind direction, cloud cover, and precipitation. Change one value at a time to see exactly how the sky responds.

items.question: Can you make a tornado in Weather Sandbox?
items.answer: Yes. A Weather Sandbox tornado needs warm moist air near the ground, cold dry air aloft, wind shear, and a lifting trigger. Build those four ingredients and the rotating updraft organizes into a funnel.

items.question: What biomes and tools can you unlock in Weather Sandbox?
items.answer: By completing experiments and contracts you unlock new biomes, tools, and storm presets. Terrain such as plains, mountains, and coastlines changes how weather behaves on each map.

items.question: Is Weather Sandbox free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Weather Sandbox is free to play on Roblox, and you can start experimenting with the full weather control panel right away.
